ex.en: I began to doubt the accuracy of his statement.
ex.zh: 我開始懷疑他陳述的準確性。

ex.en: I would like to retract my previous statement.
ex.zh: 我想撤回我之前的說法。

ex.en: The family was highly doubtful of the statement from the military.
ex.zh: 家屬對軍方的說法高度懷疑。

ex.en: I get a bank statement every month.
ex.zh: 我每個月會收到銀行對帳單。

ex.en: Check your credit card statement for errors.
ex.zh: 檢查一下信用卡帳單有沒有錯。

ex.en: He invested his money in stocks.
ex.zh: 他把錢投資在股票上。

ex.en: He lost a fortune in the stock market.
ex.zh: 他在股市賠了一大筆錢。

ex.en: This company is listed on the Paris stock exchange.
ex.zh: 這家公司在巴黎證券交易所上市。

ex.en: We have plenty of stock in the warehouse.
ex.zh: 倉庫裡存貨充足。

ex.en: That model is no longer in stock.
ex.zh: 那個型號已經沒有庫存了。

ex.en: The store stocks a wide range of organic food.
ex.zh: 這家店有賣各式各樣的有機食品。

ex.en: We need to stock up on water before the typhoon.
ex.zh: 颱風來之前我們需要多囤點水。

ex.en: National rescue teams are on standby ready to fly to Japan.
ex.zh: 各國救難隊都在待命，隨時準備飛往日本。

ex.en: The hospital keeps a generator on standby in case of a power outage.
ex.zh: 醫院準備了一台備用發電機，以防停電。

ex.en: We're on standby for the next flight to Seoul.
ex.zh: 我們在候補下一班飛往首爾的班機。

ex.en: Standby passengers can board only if there are empty seats.
ex.zh: 候補旅客只有在還有空位時才能登機。

ex.en: Go straight on to the end of the road.
ex.zh: 一直直走到這條路的盡頭。

ex.en: Go straight for two blocks.
ex.zh: 直走兩個街區。

ex.en: He drew a straight line on the wall.
ex.zh: 他在牆上畫了一條直線。

ex.en: Tom drew a straight line on the paper.
ex.zh: 湯姆在紙上畫了一道直線。

ex.en: He was ill in bed for four days straight.
ex.zh: 他一連四天臥病在床。

ex.en: It rained for three days straight.
ex.zh: 連續下了三天雨。

ex.en: You may stay here as long as you like.
ex.zh: 你想在這兒待多久就待多久。

ex.en: I would rather stay at home than go out.
ex.zh: 比起出門，我更喜歡待在家。

ex.en: We stayed at a small hotel near the station.
ex.zh: 我們住在車站附近的一間小旅館。

ex.en: How long will you be staying in Japan?
ex.zh: 你會在日本待多久？

ex.en: Enjoy your stay!
ex.zh: 祝您住宿愉快！

ex.en: During my stay in London, I visited many museums.
ex.zh: 我在倫敦停留期間參觀了很多博物館。

ex.en: I thoroughly regretted staying up so late, come morning.
ex.zh: 到了早上，我非常後悔昨晚熬夜到那麼晚。

ex.en: I stayed up all night finishing my report.
ex.zh: 我熬了一整夜把報告寫完。

stolen.zh: 被偷的（steal 的過去分詞）

ex.en: I had my wallet stolen on the bus.
ex.zh: 我的錢包在公車上被偷了。

ex.en: He had his car stolen in broad daylight.
ex.zh: 他的車在光天化日之下被偷走了。

ex.en: Our stuff got stolen, and we missed our train.
ex.zh: 我們的東西被偷走了，而且我們錯過了火車。

ex.en: Obviously, they are jealous of his wealth and status.
ex.zh: 他們很明顯在嫉妒他的財富和地位。

ex.en: I believe that a fine education can change one's social status.
ex.zh: 我相信良好的教育能改變人的社會地位。

ex.en: Can you tell me about your marital status?
ex.zh: 能告訴我你的婚姻狀況嗎？

ex.en: What's the status of my order?
ex.zh: 我的訂單現在是什麼狀態？

ex.en: The new system will streamline our ordering process.
ex.zh: 新系統能簡化我們的訂購流程。

ex.en: We streamlined the application form to just one page.
ex.zh: 我們把申請表簡化到只有一頁。

ex.en: We should get feedback from all stakeholders.
ex.zh: 我們應該聽取所有利害關係人的意見。

ex.en: Customers and employees are key stakeholders.
ex.zh: 顧客和員工都是重要的利害關係人。

ex.en: What is your stance on remote work?
ex.zh: 你對遠距工作的立場是什麼？

ex.en: The company took a firm stance against discrimination.
ex.zh: 公司對歧視採取堅決反對的立場。

ex.en: The contract stipulates that payment must be made within 30 days.
ex.zh: 合約規定必須在 30 天內付款。

ex.en: The rules stipulate a maximum of two bags per person.
ex.zh: 規定每人最多兩件行李。

ex.en: Our staff will contact you in three working days.
ex.zh: 我們的工作人員會在三個工作日內聯絡您。

ex.en: The staff in that restaurant gave us a very good impression.
ex.zh: 那家餐廳的服務人員給我們留下很好的印象。

ex.en: The entire sales staff has worked around the clock for a week.
ex.zh: 整個業務團隊連續一週日夜加班。

ex.en: All of this stationery is his.
ex.zh: 這些都是他的文具。

ex.en: What stationery isn't worth buying?
ex.zh: 哪些文具不值得買？

ex.en: Because your business can play to my strengths.
ex.zh: 因為貴公司的業務能發揮我的長處。

ex.en: To remain competitive, we've got to play to our strengths.
ex.zh: 為了保持競爭力，我們得發揮我們的優勢。

ex.en: I don't have the strength to keep trying.
ex.zh: 我沒力氣繼續嘗試了。

ex.en: He didn't have the strength to lift the box.
ex.zh: 他沒有力氣抬起那個箱子。
